result.summary: Found 2 visual layout defects in the 'Fastest near you' row: the middle restaurant card is vertically misaligned and its delivery-time badge is clipped at the image edge.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the middle card (Smash Bros Burgers) is vertically offset lower than the adjacent cards, breaking horizontal alignment.
issues.suggestion: Align all carousel cards to the same top baseline and ensure equal image heights and vertical padding in the horizontal scroll container.

issues.description: The '20-30 min' delivery time badge on the Smash Bros Burgers card is clipped at the bottom edge of the image, while badges on neighboring cards are fully visible inset from the edge.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the time badge has consistent inset margins and is not clipped by the image container overflow; fix container overflow and badge positioning.
